fullContentHtml:
SSC Junior Engineer JE Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the exam city details for the post of Junior Engineer JE. This recruitment was released for 1748 posts. Applications for the SSC CGL Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 02 September 2026, to 22 September 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 02 – 06 November 2026, 30 November 2026 & 01 December 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SSC Junior Engineer JE Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 September 2026
  • Online Correction Date : 28-30 September 2026
  • Exam Date Paper I : 02 to 06 November 2026, 30 November 2026 & 01 December 2026
  • Exam City Details : 23 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Correction Fees : Rs. 200/- (First Time)
  • Correction Fees : Rs. 500/- (Second Time)

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
